title: OpenDEA Maturity Scale Baseline
description: An immutable snapshot of the effective scale contract within a defined assessment/benchmark context (CR-AM-09 §8): scale identity + version, level definitions, progression model, scoring bands, resolution rules, effective date. A benchmark references a locked baseline; the Benchmark Assessment Contract = assessment model + version + maturity model + scale baseline + scoring rules + bands + resolution rules; every participant is evaluated under that contract. Baselines are immutable (CR-AM-09 §11 constraint 5): a locked baseline never mutates — model evolution produces a new version, not an edit. Historical reproducibility is a mandatory acceptance criterion: given the baseline, the exact model, version, scale, levels, progression, bands, and resolution rules are reconstructable without depending on today's model version. This extends the CR-AM-06 cohort snapshot and CR-AM-07 reproducibility-hash discipline to maturity semantics.

benchmark.description: The benchmark/benchmark cohort this baseline is locked to (the Benchmark Assessment Contract context).

scale.description: The MaturityScale (id + version) this baseline snapshots.

locked_at.description: The lock timestamp. After this instant the baseline never changes; evolution produces a new baseline version.

locked_by.description: The authority that locked the baseline (role or identifier).

content_hash.description: Content hash of the snapshot — the reproducibility anchor (CR-AM-06/07 discipline extended to maturity semantics). Any mutation of the snapshot invalidates the hash.

snapshot.description: The frozen effective scale contract: levels, progression, bands, and resolution rule references as they stood at lock time.

levels.description: Level definitions snapshot — id + ordinal + name + definition as locked (full semantics, so the baseline is self-contained).

band_set.description: The progress-scoring-band set (id + version) effective at lock time.

resolution_rule.description: The level-resolution rule (id + version) effective at lock time.

evaluation_model.description: The evaluation model (id + version) effective at lock time.
